preregistration.prior_evidence: EXP-0087 observed DAO create Alpha, Beta, Gamma, and Delta in sequence in one fresh database: each create added one MSysObjects row and two MSysACEs rows, appended a definition root numbered equal to its Id then a map page then one index root per index, advanced page-zero byte 1538 by two, and only the first create appended a long-value page. EXP-0091 and EXP-0107 observed DAO read exact one-table composed images whose catalog LvProp is null and whose first-create long-value page is retained empty. No experiment has observed DAO read a composed image holding more than one user table.
preregistration.hypothesis_source: Issue #100 needs create_database to accept several tables. The composer now plans later creates from the EXP-0087 observations, with a null catalog LvProp for every table and no long-value page after the first create. The smallest discriminator is one composed candidate holding the exact EXP-0087 four-table sequence compared with a fresh DAO control that creates the same four tables in the same order.
preregistration.authorization: Acquisition is forbidden until this exact plan, candidate source manifest, and every SHA-256-pinned input are reviewed, committed, and merged. A human must then explicitly authorize the one allowed local-VM dispatch.
preregistration.attempt_policy: Copy and identity-check every candidate replica before the first DAO mutation. Dispatch one three-replica run only. Once the first DAO CreateDatabase begins, any failure is a scientific result and must not be retried without another explicit human decision.

candidate_invariants.quad: The 31-page candidate holds, in create order, Alpha(Id Long); Beta(Id Long, Name Text 50, Note Memo); Gamma(Id Long) with primary index PrimaryKey on Id; and Delta(Label Text 30) with ordinary index ByLabel on Label. Every catalog LvProp is null. Only Alpha carries the retained empty first-create long-value page at page 22; Beta, Gamma, and Delta append only their definition root, map page, and index roots at pages 23 through 30. Page-zero byte 1538 is 8. The candidate is generated deterministically from the manifest-pinned Rust source through the general composer and checked through the project reader before its identity is admitted.

execution.environment: The private local Windows development VM documented in docs/LOCAL_WINDOWS_VM.md, using x86 Windows PowerShell and DAO.DBEngine.36.
execution.pre_mutation: Generate the candidate from manifest-pinned Rust source, stage and identity-check it, then copy and identity-check all three candidate replicas before creating the first DAO control.
execution.per_replica: Create and close one fresh DAO Jet 3 control holding Alpha, Beta, Gamma, and Delta created in that order; then read the pinned candidate copy and the control through the same bounded endpoint sequence. Candidate opens are read-only. Record size and SHA-256 immediately before and after endpoint reads.

endpoints: TableDefs is exactly the four expected user tables plus the four expected system tables
each user TableDef resolves by name
each table's fields enumerate with exact names, order, DAO types, and sizes
each table's indexes enumerate with exact names, flags, key names, and directions after name normalization
OpenRecordset(snapshot) succeeds and is empty for each table
each table's document resolves by name and the document inventory is exact

questions.quad: Does DAO read the exact composed four-table candidate unchanged with the same bounded schema semantics as a fresh DAO control that creates the same four tables in the same order, in all replicas?

decision_rule.observed_accepted: All three controls pass unchanged with exact replicated semantics, and all three candidate replicas pass unchanged with the same semantics.
decision_rule.not_observed_accepted: All three controls pass unchanged, while all three candidate replicas either stop at the same endpoint with identical bounded observations or complete unchanged with the same semantic mismatch.
decision_rule.no_outcome: Use when a control fails or changes, an image changes, replicas disagree, the scientific job is incomplete, or observations cannot be classified under the two rules above.
decision_rule.validation_rejection: Reject without a report for any malformed plan or result, pin or retained-identity mismatch, pre-mutation failure, inventory or bound violation, or unexpected file.
decision_rule.report_status: accepted only when the quad question is observed_accepted or not_observed_accepted; otherwise no_outcome.

evidence_boundary.establishes_only: A replicated read-only DAO observation for the exact candidate identity: whether DAO consumes a composed database holding these four tables, with null catalog LvProp values and no later-create long-value page, without repair.
not_claimed: acceptance for other table counts, orders, names, or schemas
a general LvProp, allocation, or page-assignment rule
acceptance of five or more tables
hosted write-differential evidence, general compatibility, or support-matrix movement

retention.publish: environment.json, result.json, the bounded job result, up to six exact-name MDBs including bounded post-mutation recovery artifacts, and the deterministic analyzer report.
retention.repository: Never commit MDB bytes or provider binaries. Record the validated report identity and conclusions once as one additive EXP outcome.
